thread:
mohit: Quick docs PR up — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812  Adding a mini 'provisioning playbook' with tenant quota + canary test. PTAL?

elaine: skimmed — a few micro-nits on wording. Also could we add a very short CLI example for the terraform vars so infra folks can copy-paste?

mohit: good call. I'll add a tiny example in the 'onboard' section. Prefer yaml or JSON snippet?

sam: :thumbsup: YAML feels friendlier in docs. Also re: isolation wording — prefer 'tenant isolation window' over 'isolation period' (less ambiguous). Left an inline comment.

julia: can we include a 'test traffic' curl to validate canary routing? Something devs can run against staging to confirm fallback.

mohit: yep adding both. Draft snippets below:

```yaml
# provisioning-mini-playbook.yml
tenant:
  id: example-tenant
  quota:
    gpu_hours_per_day: 24
    max_concurrent_requests: 100
canary:
  percent_of_traffic: 5
  duration_minutes: 30
  fallback_policy: 'route-to-hosted'
```

and for smoke-testing the canary:

```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"ggml-1","input":"hello world","tenant":"example-tenant"}'
```

elaine: perfect. One tiny link fix: the autoscale policy anchor changed to /docs/autoscale-policies#scale-policy-refs — I'll update the PR. Also maybe add a note about expected latency impact when enabling kv cache in the playbook.

dev-doc-bot: checklist run: link-check ✅, spell-check flagged 0, build-preview available at https://deploy-preview-812--docs.redwood.ai

sam: If CI stays green I'll merge after the wording fixes. @julia can you sanity-check the smoke curl payload vs staging behavior?

julia: ran it against staging earlier — returned 200 and the canary routing header appeared (x-rw-canary: true) for ~5% of hits. KV cache warmed after a few requests. :rocket:

mohit: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll push the small fixes Elaine mentioned and merge in 30m unless anyone objects.
